worldmenu.title: Menu settings
worldmenu.subtitle: A/D or E to change · shows at once · Save to keep
worldmenu.subtitle_dirty: ● Unsaved changes - Save to keep them
worldmenu.help.style: World panel: menus float in front of you, also while you spectate in first person or fly the free camera. Classic: the centre-screen menu.
worldmenu.help.theme: The colours of your menus. Each server starts with its own theme.
worldmenu.help.position: Where the panel sits: left of the crosshair, in the middle or on the right.
worldmenu.help.details: The pane beside menus with a description, price or rules for the item under the cursor.
worldmenu.help.save: Keep these settings. Closing this menu without saving puts the old ones back.
worldmenu.help.reset: Go back to the server's defaults (Save to keep).
worldmenu.help.discard: Undo the changes you have not saved.
worldmenu.help.test: Saves, then opens a sample menu and tells you in chat whether the world panel could be drawn.
worldmenu.style_set: {default}Menu style: {gold}{0}{default}. Type {green}!menustyle{default} for themes, position and size.
worldmenu.failed: {red}The world menu could not be drawn ({0}). Showing the classic menu - tell an admin, or use {green}!menustyle center{red}.
worldmenu.test.title: World menu test
worldmenu.test.subtitle: W/S move · A/D tabs · E select
worldmenu.test.result: {default}Menu test: style {gold}{0}{default}, follow {gold}{1}{default}, alive {gold}{2}{default}, panel entities {gold}{3}{default}, last error {grey}{4}{default}.
